item: r628 lock fixtures raise where SQLAlchemy wraps the error
summary: The fixtures raised sqlite3 database is locked from a before_cursor_execute listener, which SQLAlchemy 2.0.51 runs outside its error handling, so five tests saw a raw sqlite3 error instead of the wrapped OperationalError and failed on every local run, even alone. They now raise from do_execute and do_executemany, inside the handling, so hide_parameters is exercised as a real locked database would exercise it.
